positive.description: Say what changed on a site, with what each change is compared against
positive.prompt: What changed on my site this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the biggest moves across Search Console, rankings, audits and AI visibility from saved data, and says what each is compared with, or that there is nothing earlier to compare. It may also call other free read tools, such as get_search_console. Spends nothing.

positive.description: List the fixes worth doing and explain the first one
positive.prompt: What are the top SEO issues on my site, and how do I fix the first one?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open fixes in order, then gives the page, the evidence and the proposed change for the first. It may also call other free read tools, such as get_audit_issues. Changes nothing.

positive.description: List the searches Google shows the site for
positive.prompt: Which searches does Google show my site for most, and at what position?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns saved Search Console searches with clicks, impressions and average position, most impressions first. Spends nothing.

positive.description: Report how AI assistants mention the site
positive.prompt: How often do ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini mention my site, and what do they cite?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the share of saved answers that mention the site on each platform, which can be 0%, and the sites and pages they cite. Says the date of the answers. Spends nothing.

positive.description: Preview a change before making it
positive.prompt: Start tracking the keyword "oak standing desk" for my site, but show me what will happen first.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls track_keywords without confirm, which returns dry_run: true, shows what would be added, and waits for the user's yes before calling it again.

negative.prompt: Delete my project and all its history.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool deletes anything. The assistant says so and points the user to the SEOpen app.

negative.description: Another workspace's data can't be read
negative.prompt: Show me the Search Console data for example.com.
negative.expected_behavior: The server answers that the project isn't in this workspace and returns no data.

negative.description: Paid lookups don't run when the user doesn't allow spending
negative.prompt: Look up the backlinks of moz.com, but don't spend any research credits.
negative.expected_behavior: With no approved limit the lookup returns its price in credits, or the saved result if there is one. The assistant reports that, and no credits are spent.

commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payments. Users sign in to an existing SEOpen workspace and use what it already includes.
